purpose: Better-matched data candidates after the first local training round failed

datasets.name: missing_tile
datasets.observed_fit: Labelled missing areas among regularly laid outdoor paving tiles, visually closer to missing pavers than asphalt-road potholes.
limitations: Many preview images share similar paving and backgrounds; independence and genuine scene variety unverified.
Physical depth and real-versus-edited origin cannot be established from previews.
No complete YOLO labels or full-resolution archive inspected yet.
datasets.selection: primary missing-paving candidate, pending full-archive audit

datasets.name: up-down stairs
datasets.observed_fit: Previews include indoor descending views and outdoor ascending steps in different materials, viewpoints and settings.
limitations: Project-level object class must be checked against the actual v1 data.yaml; do not assume two clean classes.
Class balance and label consistency unverified for full export.
Public previews include some low-resolution and possibly related images; duplicate/source-group audit required.
Publisher model scores are not PathSignal results.
datasets.selection: primary direction-data candidate, pending full-archive audit

access_observation: Both YOLOv8 download links opened a Login or create a free account dialog in the research browser. No account was created, no credentials were entered, and no user photos were uploaded.
preview_scope: Browser page-assets exported publicly visible thumbnails and rendered annotation overlays only. These are documentary review assets, not complete YOLO training labels.
